info.title: livepeer.errors.v1
info.description: The base error kinds every registry entry maps its runners' errors to, and the fixed retry rule of each. A gateway decides whether to retry from the kind alone.

ErrorKind.description: A base error kind; x-retry is its retry rule

oneOf.description: The request doesn't match the profile's schema or rules
The request is well formed but asks for something this runner doesn't support, such as a model, format or size
The runner is at capacity; no work started
The runner can't serve now, such as a missing model, GPU or encoder; no work started
The work ran past its deadline; it may have happened
The work ran but its output couldn't be produced or delivered
A backend or vendor the runner depends on failed during the work
Any other failure inside the runner, including errors the entry doesn't map
The runner couldn't read an input, such as a URL it can't fetch or an expired grant
The request itself is wrong; a retry fails the same way
No work started; the same request may go to another runner at once
Work may have happened; only whoever owns the attempt may retry
The caller must fix something first, such as access to an input

ClassifiedError.description: A runner error as a gateway classified it, for surfaces such as MCP tool results

status.description: The runner's HTTP status, when there was one
